title: Read-only and default tables
description:
Control table access with `__index` and `__newindex`.

```
config.width   -> 800
config.colour  -> "blue" (from the defaults)
config.width = 1 -> error: config is read-only
counts.apple   -> 0 (never nil)
```

starter.main.lua:
local function with_defaults(t, defaults)
  return t
end

local function read_only(t)
  return t
end

local config = read_only(with_defaults({ width = 800 }, { colour = "blue" }))
print(config.width, config.colour)

hints: `read_only` returns an empty table with `__index = t` and `__newindex = function() error("config is read-only", 2) end`.
requirements: `with_defaults(t, defaults)` returns a table that falls back to `defaults`.
`read_only(t)` returns a proxy whose `__newindex` raises an error.
`default_zero()` returns a table where missing keys read as 0.
stretch: Make `pairs` work on the read-only proxy with `__pairs`.
